hook_line: WHITE HOUSE CLEARS PERM GREEN CARD OVERHAUL

hook_stat.sub: Last comprehensive update of the PERM regulations

stats.label: White House review of the overhaul completed

diaspora_bullets: PERM is the first step for most EB-2 and EB-3 green cards
Indian applicants are the largest group in those queues
news_summary: The Department of Labor's proposed PERM overhaul cleared White House review on October 23 and heads to the Federal Register, covering recruitment standards, layoff rules and nondiscrimination requirements.
payoff: Current PERM filings continue under the existing rules until a final rule is issued.
